items.title: ICICI Lombard Q2 net profit growth 15.5%; Rs 7 dividend announced
items.description: ICICI Lombard General Insurance achieved a net profit of ₹946 crore in the second quarter of FY2023, reflecting a 15.5% increase. The insurer reported strong performance in its motor and commercial segments, contributing to this growth. Gross premium income increased by 3% to ₹6,792 crore compared to the previous year. In addition, the company declared a dividend of ₹7 per share for the first half of the financial year.

items.title: Canara Bank net profit up 8.4%, treasury losses weigh
items.description: Canara Bank experienced an 8.4% year-on-year increase in net profit, reaching ₹5,175 crore for Q2 FY27. The bank's improvement in asset quality contributed to this profit growth, alongside core income expansion. However, mark-to-market losses from rising bond yields limited higher earnings outcomes. Its gross non-performing assets ratio also improved, declining to 1.3% from both the previous quarter and last year.

items.title: Orient Electric Q2 profit jumps two-fold to Rs 27 crore, revenue rises 25% YoY
items.description: Orient Electric Ltd has revealed a remarkable increase in net profit, soaring to Rs 27.06 crore in Q2 FY27, marking a more than two-fold jump from Rs 12.06 crore in the same quarter of the previous year. Additionally, the company reported a 25.15 percent growth in revenue from operations, totaling Rs 879.34 crore, with Electrical Consumer Durables revenue up by 24.85 percent to Rs 550.5 crore.

items.title: Nestle India Q2 Results: Standalone profit jumps 36% YoY to Rs 1,027 crore, revenue rises 20%
items.description: In the second quarter of FY27, Nestle India achieved a remarkable standalone net profit of Rs 1,027 crore, marking a substantial 36% increase from last year's Rs 753 crore. Revenue from operations soared to Rs 6,788 crore, a 20% rise from Rs 5,644 crore. However, despite these impressive results, shares fell by 7% to Rs 1,260 on the NSE, reflecting a mixed market response.
